asr.full_text: Hello, this is Ryan, residual Bitcoin miner. And I wanted to make an announcement about Sierra Leone Bitcoin Network down there. And I just made a nice little $33 donation to help Cherno, Seed, Sal to join the Bitcoin Club Network. And we're actually raising money to help them start mining Bitcoin down in Sierra Leone and get them into a mining pool and then bring Bitcoin merchant processing down that way as this is just so exciting. I mean I'm working with my friend Daniel, Daniel Model from New York City. He's done a lot of fundraisers, working with the CEO of Overstock.com, helping the homeless out, bringing money out. There there's something I'm very passionate about. I believe that if you're going to go ahead and help the world, you have to start at the very, very bottom where the poor who have been affected most by the corruption of the banking system out there. And we need to help these people that want to be helped actually take part. And I know that Cherno is one of the people out there over in Sierra Leone and that wants to make a difference is that sees the full potential of Bitcoin and how it can help the country and take the wealth of the world and go ahead and decentralize that the money once again for the people. There is no reason on earth why anyone should be homeless. There is no reason on earth why people should not have a roof over their head. There is no reason why little children should die of malnutrition, I cannot imagine this being the case, being a parent myself of two beautiful little daughters, that really kills the soul inside when someone can't provide for their families, and this is something that I will not stand for and I know my business partners Daniel Model and also Joby Weeks do not stand- will not stand for and tolerate and when we know that bitcoin is the way to help these countries out there. So, you know congratulations, Cherno. We're excited that you are leading the charge over there in Sierra Leone when it comes to getting bitcoin out to the masses and stuff and we're very excited. We have full faith that that Bitcoin network in bitcoin merchant processing we are bringing, to the people, that pays the people come this February. Is going to completely change everything, is the distribution model of Bitcoin that the world has been waiting for and it's got to help the people out there and that's our full intention so if anyone else wants to go ahead and make a donation to help out Cherno under this YouTube video I'm going to have a QR excuse me A a bitcoin wallet address that you can send this the money will go towards helping them mine bitcoin at bitclub network and help them spread the word about what we're doing to bring some financial stability into these countries. So thank you so much for watching this guys. Just so excited about this. I in in what is possible with those who want to take part in this so Looking forward to receiving donations again. This goes straight to Chernow and into this special fund to help this. Thank you so much. Bye. Bye

textual.context: Presented as a promotional fundraising appeal associated with the Sierra Leone Bitcoin Network; the speaker describes the intended use of the donation.
textual.potential_relevance: A requested cryptocurrency transfer is directly linked to a stated fundraising purpose and a named network, warranting assessment of the donation destination, fund handling, and whether the stated use is supported.
textual.limitations: These records do not establish whether donations were received, who controlled the wallet, whether the funds reached the stated recipients, or whether mining occurred.

textual_context_notes.observation: The speaker characterizes the donation as going directly to a named person and a special fund.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because the speaker solicits Bitcoin donations to place named people into the BitClub Network and fund their mining participation, presenting a commercial mining arrangement as humanitarian aid. He encourages viewers to send money to a wallet address and claims the network will pay people and bring financial stability, which promotes participation through an income-related mining promise.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S04 fits because the requested payment is described as funding membership or participation in a Bitcoin mining network and mining pool, with the activity linked to earning or payment. The video is promotional rather than investigative and directly directs viewers to donate through a Bitcoin wallet.
